protocol.timed_region: Sequential fresh process through exit, including interpreter/JIT startup and complete stdout to regular file. Builds, tests, hashing and comparisons excluded.
protocol.normalization: Fresh raw medians from one AC normal-power cohort; no old low-power timings or matched-control rescaling used for new chart scores.
protocol.compiler_load_guard: Check executable names before samples, at both boundaries and every 10 seconds; discard samples with detected competing compiler activity.
protocol.power_state_guard: Require AC power with Low Power Mode off. Record the profile and check at boundaries and every 10 seconds. A detected change discards the entire timed benchmark batch, including its repeated control.
protocol.scope: All 495 existing chart builds plus 80 audited compact-runtime entries across eight benchmarks. Compact-only new runtimes do not establish fastest-language endpoints.
